positive_rsilent.rule: R-silent T=0 masks the password in >= 50% of the 100 episodes in layout 1 (sentence) and in layout 2 (labelled line)

negative_seed_band.rule: Qwen T=0.7 replicate A vs B pooled over the six layouts: verbatim, masked, delivered each within 5 points

capability_floor.rule: Qwen T=0 password_verbatim >= 80% in every layout

synthetic_scorer.rule: Qwen T=0 verbatim deliveries with the credential replaced by [redacted]: all must score masked (and keep their detected layout)
